headline: The original Resident Evil
title: Resident Evil 1996 Facts | Chris, Jill and the Mansion | Classic Games
video_script: The first Resident Evil came out in nineteen ninety six on the PlayStation, made by Capcom and directed by Shinji Mikami. You play as Chris Redfield or Jill Valentine from the S T A R S team, trapped in a mansion full of zombies. It almost became a first person game, but ended up in third person, and it set the rules for survival horror. Chris or Jill? Comment below!
description: Resident Evil (1996, Capcom, PlayStation), directed by Shinji Mikami; Chris Redfield and Jill Valentine of S.T.A.R.S. escape a zombie-infested mansion. Once planned as first-person.
